name: Career Forge — AI Resume & Job Match Studio
tagline: Instant ATS match scoring, XYZ bullet rewrites, cover letters & interview prep.
description:
Career Forge turns Anna into your personal AI Career & ATS Optimization Studio. Paste any resume and job description (or try a 1-click role preset) to get an instant, transparent ATS compatibility breakdown, missing keyword radar, quantified XYZ bullet rewrites, tailored cover letters, and STAR interview prep questions.

**What's inside**

- **ATS Match & Keyword Radar** — Deterministic multi-factor scoring across Technical Skills, Role Keywords, Quantified Impact, and ATS Formatting.
- **XYZ Bullet Optimizer** — Rewrites weak experience lines into measurable, high-impact achievement statements infused with missing job keywords.
- **Tailored Cover Letter & Outreach Generator** — Crafts role-specific cover letters and recruiter outreach messages in one click.
- **Targeted STAR Interview Prep** — Generates technical and behavioral interview questions focused on your exact skill gaps.
- **Persistent Scan History** — Automatically tracks your scan history, best match scores, and drafts via Anna Storage and the Career Engine plugin.

**How to use**

Open Career Forge from your Anna App Deck or mention `#career-forge` in any chat. Click any role preset or paste your resume and target job description, then click **Run ATS Match Scan**.
